_comments.about: Packaged defaults; read-only. Override a setting by putting the same key, with a value of the same type, in the user's config.json (see the README). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_comments.paths: <prefix> is the client's directory on the server (e.g. renate-od); <key> is the relative path of a file below it. The same <prefix>/<key> is used on every route, so the local tree mirrors the server.
_comments.host: Data server, for SSH and HTTPS.
_comments.port: SSH port of the data server.
_comments.user: SSH user. Relative roots below are resolved by SFTP from this user's home directory (/home/data).
_comments.private_root: SFTP only (downloads and uploads of private data): <private_root>/<prefix>/<key>, e.g. private_html/renate-od/<key> = /home/data/private_html/renate-od/<key>. Never served over HTTP.
_comments.public_root: SFTP only (uploads of public data): <public_root>/<prefix>/<key>, e.g. public_html/renate-od/<key>. This is the folder Apache serves at public_url, so public downloads go over HTTPS instead.
_comments.public_url: HTTPS only (downloads of public data, no key needed): <public_url>/<prefix>/<key>, e.g. https://deep.reak.bme.hu/~data/renate-od/<key>. Apache maps ~data to /home/data/public_html, so these are the same files as public_root.
_comments.host_keys: SSH host keys trusted for host:port, in OpenSSH format, in addition to the user's own known_hosts; any other host key is rejected. ED25519 key verified on the server on 2026-10-06 (SHA256:usX2dUJQMwMew4aipu0soHO1cVN62JtI2L6uYT1oI7o).
_comments.working_dirs: Always empty here. In config.json it maps a client prefix to its saved working directory (an absolute path), as set by DataClient.set_working_dir.
